_doc: Region recipe: Frostbloom (Nyxaris's homeland). Data only. Schema: design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Source: bible section 27. Glacial systems intersect geothermal vents; enormous flowers grow around thermal pockets; ice forms around boiling channels; life survives through precise boundaries. Silk is bridge, trap, insulation, record, nursery and territorial marker, and pattern communicates authorship.
name: Frostbloom
summary: Where glacier meets geothermal vent. Heat and cold share one landscape, separated by precise boundaries. Flowers the size of buildings open around warm pockets, and silk crosses everything.

surfaces.desc: Dark rock kept warm by a vent below.
Soft petals fallen around the flowers, warm and damp.

ground.relief: rolling ice, steep vent chimneys, wide flower basins

sky.ambient: cold blue with pockets of warmth

props.note: Building-sized flowers growing around thermal pockets.
A silk line marking territory or a nursery. It communicates. Crossing it is a decision.
A span of frozen silk; supports weight, reads tension.
Periodic scalding jets with a visible warning.
Silk that records testimony. Pattern and structure are one.
Pattern art, often a boundary marker.

flora: frost bloom, steam lily, cinder moss, glass thistle

creatures.name: Frost Moth
creatures.desc: A large pale moth that pollinates the blooms.
creatures.behavior: Passive. Silk-dust on its wings warns of vent flares.

creatures.name: Rime Beetle
creatures.desc: A rime-coated beetle that grazes on cinder moss.
creatures.behavior: Docile. Burrows under warm stone in vent flares.

creatures.name: Vent Skater
creatures.desc: A thin-legged skater that runs over scalding channels.

creatures.name: Icefall Stalker
creatures.desc: A pale hunter that waits under overhangs.
creatures.behavior: Strikes when a target crosses a silk line.

music.stinger_on_event: a plucked string that rings under ice

encounters.ambient: ice creak, vent hiss, silk hum

world_states.label: Extraction
world_states.effect: Helix recovery drones harvest silk. Boundary lines are cut.

world_states.label: Fire
world_states.effect: Vent flares are more frequent; the bloom ring shrinks.

bondable_here.hook: Her homeland. Silk boundaries and the Helix recovery agent test her trust.
Unstable ice roads: a place to close a road on purpose.

descent_events.title: A line of silk across the ice
descent_events.text: A single line of frozen silk runs across the glacier, tensioned precisely. A nursery sits on the far side. A shortcut crosses the line and saves an hour. Nyxaris walks to the line, stops, and does not look at you.

choices.label: Read the line before you do anything.
choices.result: The silk says: nursery, do not cross, ask. Nyxaris relaxes by a degree.

choices.label: Stay behind the line and go the long way.
choices.result: The long way is an hour longer. Nyxaris walks beside you the whole way.

choices.label: Cross. It is only silk.
choices.result: The silk sings. The icefall stalkers come out from under the overhang. Nyxaris's temperature drops.

descent_events.title: Helix recovery team
descent_events.text: A Helix recovery team reels silk off a frozen span into sample sleeves, tagging each sleeve with a barcode. The Recovery Agent has papers for everything. None of them are signed by anyone from here.

choices.label: Refuse the agent's offer of a recovery fee.
choices.result: 'It is generous,' the agent says. 'It is also not offered twice.'

choices.label: Photograph the harvest and the missing signatures.
choices.result: Mara can use this. So can Nyxaris's lawyers.

choices.label: Take the fee and look away.
choices.result: The money is real. The silk is gone.

choices.label: Quietly take a copy of the agent's authorization records.
choices.result: The records are useful. The agent is no longer comfortable.

descent_events.title: A moth in the vent field
descent_events.text: A Frost Moth is stuck on a warm stone surrounded by vent jets, wings icing over. It flutters in short bursts.

choices.label: Time the jets and carry it out.
choices.result: It climbs your arm, shakes off the ice and leaves.

choices.label: Leave a warm rock beside it and walk on.
choices.result: It will probably live.

choices.label: Net it for a Habitat chain.
choices.result: It will need a bloom chain. It is not happy about the net.

descent_events.title: Vent flare
descent_events.text: The warning tone is a rising hiss, then a low roar. A bloom ring is about to be scalded. A silk bridge crosses it with two travelers midway.

choices.label: Call the crossing off and guide them down the ice chimney.
choices.result: They climb down on your line. The bridge boils away behind them.

choices.label: Brace the bridge's anchor so it survives the flare.
choices.result: Aruun sets Morrow against the anchor and holds. The silk holds too.

choices.label: Run the span and hope.
choices.result: You make it. The travelers behind you do not.

descent_events.title: An ice road that should not stay open
descent_events.text: A road of ice and silk crosses a field of thin ice. It saves two days between settlements and has already killed three travelers who trusted it. A signboard says only: OPEN.

choices.label: Close it. Say why, and mark the alternate route.
choices.result: The settlements argue, then agree. The long route gets a lantern.

choices.label: Lay a second route along the stable ice.
choices.result: It takes an hour. It is slower. It is safe.

choices.label: Keep it open and sell passage.
choices.result: Travelers pay. One does not arrive.

descent_events.title: A marker under the frost
descent_events.text: A marker stone is encased in clear ice. Its symbols match the Red Reaches and the Canopy Fold. A silk line is tied around it, very old, with a pattern nobody here can name.

choices.label: Ask Nyxaris to read the silk.
choices.result: She runs a leg along the line and reads for a long time. 'Not Frostbloom. Not now. It is a record, anyway.'

choices.label: Chip the ice off to copy the symbols.
choices.result: The ice cracks. The silk goes slack.

descent_events.title: A silk archive
descent_events.text: A cold-silk panel holds testimony from a displaced Critter family. You can read it in translation if you ask. It is also a person's whole account.

choices.label: Ask Nyxaris for permission before you touch the panel.
choices.result: She says, 'You asked.' She does not say anything else, which is the highest compliment.

choices.label: Scan it without asking.
choices.result: The scan is accurate and rude.

descent_events.title: The silk you took
descent_events.text: A thread you cut hangs in the wind, one end still tied to a bridge. Nyxaris stands by the loose end, saying nothing.

choices.label: Retie the thread, tension as you remember it. Ask her to check it.
choices.result: She tugs once and says, 'Wrong.' She fixes it. 'Close.'

descent_events.title: The road that stayed open
descent_events.text: A signboard at the end of the ice road still says OPEN. Solthrin stands at the edge of it, grove dim.

choices.label: Close it now. Take the board down and carry it back.
choices.result: 'Better late,' Solthrin says. A branch on his grove lights.
